universe: warehouse SIP top-400 by prior-day dollar volume, ETFs/ETPs excluded; at the signal bar's close price $20-$400 and up >= 1.5% vs prior close (the desk band, live)
bars: 5-minute bars built from SIP 1-minute bars aligned to 09:30 (the prior session's full 78 bars prepended for warm-up); a signal is read at a COMPLETED 5-minute bar; entry = open of the next 1-minute bar
lines_5m: fast %R (21, EWM 7) and slow %R (28, EWM 3) on 5-minute bars (28 = the desk's existing 5-minute slow length, wr_slow_5m)

signals (3 deciding cells, Bonferroni).BOX5: the desk's pre-square rule on 5-minute lines: fast >= -35, slow >= -35, |fast - slow| <= 15, not both >= -20, fast rising (> 0.05); trigger on the second consecutive true bar (not a third)
signals (3 deciding cells, Bonferroni).TREND5: close > EMA20 of 5-minute closes AND EMA20 above its value 3 bars earlier AND close > session VWAP (1-minute typical price x volume from 09:30) AND higher low (the lowest low of the last 6 bars > the lowest low of the 6 bars before); trigger on the first bar it becomes true
signals (3 deciding cells, Bonferroni).LOWHEAT5: heat5 = 100 + fast 5-minute %R < 40, rising on this bar and the previous one, not the one before

exit (same for all): first of: a -3% stop from entry (fill at the stop, or the 1-minute bar open if it gapped through); the close of the first completed 5-minute bar after entry where the fast 5-minute %R turns down (lower than the bar before) after having been >= -20 since entry; else the 15:55 close
cost: real SIP quoted spread in the 60 s before entry (news_source.fetch_quotes); spread > 15 bp not traded; net = gross - spread
sample: <= 4,000 entries per (signal, period) by the lowest sha256('s5m'|day|sym|t)

pass_each.edge: mean net >= +5.0 bp per trade on DECIDE
pass_each.both_halves: mean net > 0 in both date halves of DECIDE
